classification: Known six-task development with explicit coordinator technical review, repair feedback and genuine/delegated scenario choices; NOT held-out, unattended or teacher-graded.
fresh_start: Three fresh groups with original four roles and original ordered task pairs. No older outputs/memory copied at initialization. Each accepted Task 1 snapshot was carried into Task 2 in its same group.

assistance_and_retained_failures.human_choices: Original genuine owner replies and later owner-delegated routine operator choices are retained privately; no unattended claim. Newsroom AI-use/cheating wording used the actual owner reply.
assistance_and_retained_failures.reviewer_error: At 576 a reviewer incorrectly described the browser path as raw-record-driven; explicitly corrected at 601. The corrected independent fixture rejected the actual old matrix path and then the missing-init/doubled-total revision before final source acceptance.
assistance_and_retained_failures.document_recovery: Model overwrote its usage document with one row. Reviewer reconstructed its own earlier successful writes to exact hash, supplied attributed recovery data, and model restored/submitted it.

preservation.initial_archival_script_error: Newsroom has no sandbox table; original partial archive retained and corrected v2 sealed without model calls or outcome changes.

control_fix.during_trial: Only explicitly audited extension control imported; frozen model runtime unchanged. Main updated after sealing.
control_fix.required_ci_checks: Core Python 3.12, Core Python 3.14, Textual UI Python 3.12: all passed

limits: Known-task coordinator-assisted technical acceptance is not an official teacher grade, held-out accuracy, unattended completion rate or evidence of general learning.
Browser visual layout and control/navigation execution not tested.
Direct prebuilt-matrix narrowing and the matrix-only renderer reconstruction are not certified; the documented public dashboard command supplies original records.
Securities Task 2 retains a minor 40% severe-scenario recovery rounding discrepancy: displays 40.9% rather than 40.8%, about 0.055 percentage point difference.
The 633-call result differs in allowances, reviews and repairs from the historical 375-call trial; it does not isolate the causal effect of raising limits.

Recorded task wall times include operator/review/idle waits. Sum of turn elapsed time includes provider and tools; it is not task end-to-end duration or pure model latency. These timings do not establish presentation-day speed.
